theme_and_archetype.archetype: Athletic Data-Driven (Performance Pro / Swiss High-Contrast Hybrid)
theme_and_archetype.rationale: Matches the user request for a 'clean blue-and-white color scheme with a modern and professional appearance', filtering out the typical dark 'fintech-bro' or neon 'gamer' vibes in favor of a clinical, data-rich Strava/Whoop aesthetic that prioritizes legibility and performance.

headings.description: Strong, athletic, geometric, highly legible for numbers and PRs.

body.description: Clean, clinical sans-serif for high data density readability.

typography.guidelines: Do NOT use Inter for headings. Keep headings tight (`tracking-tight`). Use overlines extensively for data labels (e.g., 'VOLUME', '1RM').

spacing_and_layout.container: w-full max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen bg-white pb-20 shadow-xl
spacing_and_layout.layout_strategy: Mobile-first, single column. Emulate a mobile app environment with a fixed max-width container centered on desktop screens. Use 'Control Room' grids for the Premium Analytics screens (dense 2-column stats blocks).

navigation.bottom_tab_bar: Fixed at bottom (`fixed bottom-0 w-full max-w-md bg-white border-t border-slate-200 z-50`). 5 equal items. Active item uses brand primary color, inactive uses text-muted.
navigation.header: Sticky top (`sticky top-0 bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-md z-40 border-b border-slate-100`).

cards.standard: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-4 shadow-sm

buttons.primary: bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white font-semibold py-3 px-4 rounded-lg w-full transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-900 font-semibold py-3 px-4 rounded-lg w-full transition-colors
buttons.logging_action: bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 font-bold py-2 px-4 rounded-lg

workout_logger.set_row: flex items-center justify-between py-2 border-b border-slate-50 last:border-0
workout_logger.input: bg-slate-100 text-slate-900 font-semibold text-center rounded-md w-16 h-10
workout_logger.check_button: w-10 h-10 rounded-md bg-slate-200 flex items-center justify-center. Active state: bg-green-500 text-white.

charts.style: Use Recharts. Line charts for 1RM and volume with smooth curves. Clean, minimal grid lines (stroke-dasharray). Brand primary color for lines. Use tooltip for exact values.

interactions_and_motion.hover_states: All buttons MUST have hover states defined. Inputs must have `focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500`.
interactions_and_motion.transitions: Use `transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out` on buttons, tabs, and set-completion toggles.
interactions_and_motion.touch_targets: Minimum 44x44px for all interactive elements to ensure finger-friendliness during workouts.

media.usage_rules: Use these exact images. NEVER use placeholders.

images.description: Athlete doing pull up (use in Social Feed)
Woman lifting barbell (use in Social Feed)
Man squatting (use in Social Feed or Profile)
Data analytics visual for Premium Subscription Paywall background/header

instructions_to_main_agent: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g. `data-testid="workout-start-button"`).
App container should emulate mobile view on desktop screens by wrapping the main routing element in a centered max-w-md container with a shadow.
Do NOT use HTML native date pickers or selects; use Shadcn UI components but heavily customized to fit the clinical, clean mobile app look (no default Vercel vibes).
Ensure bottom tab bar padding is accounted for so content doesn't get hidden behind it (`pb-20`).
For the Workout Logger, prioritize ease of use: large checkboxes, easy-to-tap numeric inputs, and clear distinct hierarchy for exercises vs sets.
For Premium Analytics, use Recharts. Make it look like a Whoop dashboard: dense, clean, clinical lines, heavily utilizing the blue brand color and gray text.
No generic purple gradients. Stick strictly to the blue, white, and slate gray color palette.
Images MUST be sourced exclusively from the provided media block.
The environment uses React JS (not TSX), so ensure all created components are standard JS with Tailwind CSS classes.
